top_signals.title: Trump Announces Plan to Let Ranchers Process Their Own Food
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump said he plans to authorize farmers and ranchers to process their own food, the administration’s latest move targeting US meatpackers in an effort to bring down high beef prices.  Will Harris Owner and operator of White Oak Pastures joined Balance of Power to discuss this as well as how the Iran War is affecting the farming industry as a whole.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
